destination.title: Inflation and accelerated cosmology: mechanisms and consistency
destination.question: Which mechanisms support inflation or related accelerated phases, and how do dynamical, quantum, observational and conjectural conditions constrain them?
destination.summary: A heterogeneous navigation family is supported. Potential tests, modified dynamics, entropy and particle-spectrum bounds, quantum initial states, microscopic constructions and self-reproduction ask different questions. Their connections do not establish equivalence or quantum-gravity completion.

systems: De Sitter particle and horizon systems
targets: Realization and consistency of accelerated phases
Perturbations, duration, initial states and stability
Boundary applications to magnetogenesis and dark energy
regimes: Exact and approximate de Sitter backgrounds
assumptions: Numerical membership is a retrieval proposal.
Conjectures are conditional criteria, not established sufficient conditions for ultraviolet completion.
Different dimensions, fields, actions and cosmological phases remain distinguishable.
conventions: Geometric slow roll and potential derivative ratios are not interchangeable without the source's dynamical assumptions.
Source-local graph relations retain their extracted meaning.
Observational agreement is dated to the source's stated inputs.
includes: Unresolved constructions and negative compatibility results
Alternate access to sources outside a potential-conjecture core
excludes: A universal inflationary exclusion or completion theorem
Automatic identification of different conjecture versions
Canonical question equivalence inferred from numerical proximity

sources.title: G-inflation: Inflation driven by the Galileon field

evidence.text: Can a Galileon-like derivative interaction drive inflation with second-order field equations, produce curvature fluctuations on exact de Sitter space, and permit stable NEC violation and altered tensor predictions?

sources.title: Phenomenological Consequences of the Refined Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Does the conjecture constrain each metastable inflationary branch or only the lowest-energy branch? The source leaves this choice unresolved for pure natural inflation.

sources.title: A Note on the Swampland Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: Can horizon ordering and entropy bounds restrict scalar-field motion during inflation? The paper examines black holes and a thermal many-species surrogate in de Sitter or quasi-de Sitter spacetime, with an abstract-level reference to fast-roll inflation.

sources.title: Inflation, Higher Spins and the Swampland

evidence.text: The relevant consistency test concerns massive higher-spin particles during approximately de Sitter inflation. The background curvature sets a mass threshold, while the scalar excursion changes tower masses. The principal calculation holds H and the initial mass normalization fixed.

sources.title: Generalizing the swampland: Embedding $P(X, \varphi)$ inflationary theories in a curved multifield space

evidence.text: Can a slowly evolving P(X,ϕ) inflationary background have a sufficiently steep potential in this curved two-field extension to meet the de Sitter gradient conjecture?

sources.title: Swampland de Sitter conjectures in no-scale supergravity models

evidence.text: Which parameter choices make toy no-scale supergravity de Sitter models compatible with the refined de Sitter conjecture (RdSC) and trans-Planckian censorship conjecture (TCC), and can added rolling fields stabilize the no-scale sector while retaining conjecture compatibility?

sources.title: Two-field inflationary model and swampland de Sitter conjecture

evidence.text: The conjectures are introduced as proposed restrictions on inflationary effective theories compatible with quantum gravity. The distance criterion concerns field variation, while the de Sitter criterion concerns a normalized potential slope.

sources.title: Exploring the Parameter Space of Inflation Model on the Brane and its Compatibility with the Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: Can inverse monomial inflation on a brane produce suitable inflationary observables while satisfying refined de Sitter, further-refined de Sitter, scalar weak gravity and strong scalar weak gravity conjectures?

sources.title: Inflation and de Sitter conjectures in 8-dimensional $R+γR^n$ Gravity

evidence.text: How do single-field and two-field inflationary potentials obtained from eight-dimensional higher-curvature gravity perform against the paper's cited inflationary constraints and original, refined, and further-refined de Sitter conjectures?

sources.title: Two-Field Quintessential Higgs Model and the Swampland

evidence.text: Does an inflationary extension of an exponentially coupled Higgs–quintessence potential satisfy the stated de Sitter Swampland conjecture while agreeing with CMB observables, and can it retain the previously proposed Higgs-stability mechanism?

sources.title: G-inflation: Inflation driven by the Galileon field

evidence.text: Expand to quadratic order in unitary-gauge perturbations and eliminate lapse and shift through their constraints. Use dy=c_s dτ and a canonically normalized mode to obtain a Sasaki–Mukhanov-type equation, then evaluate the spectrum with Hankel modes.

sources.title: Phenomenological Consequences of the Refined Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Differentiate the full potential, partition the valid trajectory by curvature, and test the gradient wherever curvature is insufficient. Replace this interval audit by one transition value only after verifying monotonicity and coverage.

sources.title: A Note on the Swampland Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: Normalize two object constraints to the same variable, compare their endpoints, and substitute model-specific scaling laws afterward. Here the black-hole mass is eliminated first, separating the species consistency bound from the assumed exponential field dependence.

sources.title: Inflation, Higher Spins and the Swampland

evidence.text: Insert m=m0(s) exp(-lambda Delta phi) into an applicable threshold m>B(s,H), then solve for Delta phi. Keep state labels fixed during this inversion. Only afterward combine constraints over the spectrum and its field-dependent validity domain.

sources.title: Generalizing the swampland: Embedding $P(X, \varphi)$ inflationary theories in a curved multifield space

evidence.text: Normalize the background velocity, differentiate it covariantly, construct the normal direction, and project the field equations and potential derivatives into this orthonormal basis.

sources.title: Swampland de Sitter conjectures in no-scale supergravity models

evidence.text: For the seed analysis, a quartic Kähler deformation fixes Re φ = b. Writing φ = x + iy then gives the effective canonical imaginary field σ = √(3α/2)y/b.

sources.title: Swampland Constraints on No-Boundary Quantum Cosmology

evidence.text: Can the traditional Hartle–Hawking state give appreciable relative weight to classical inflationary universes when Einstein gravity with a scalar field obeys the assumed distance and refined de Sitter conjectures?

sources.title: Kontsevich-Segal Criterion in the No-Boundary State Constrains Inflation

evidence.text: Does imposing the Kontsevich–Segal criterion on complex saddles of the semiclassical Hartle–Hawking no-boundary wave function select inflationary potentials and constrain the tensor-to-scalar ratio? What causes saddles to lose allowability during an approximately classical inflationary phase?

sources.title: Higgs inflation and its extensions and the further refining dS swampland conjecture

evidence.text: Can metric Higgs inflation, Palatini Higgs inflation, and Higgs–Dilaton inflation satisfy the further-refined de Sitter conjecture through suitable choices of its parameters, despite reported tension with the earlier refined conjecture?

sources.title: Gauss–Bonnet Inflation and the String Swampland

evidence.text: Do the adopted quantum-gravity conjectures point toward a particular curvature coupling in inflation?

sources.title: Type I Hilltop Inflation and the Refined Swampland Criteria

evidence.text: Can a small field hilltop model fit CMB observables and satisfy the refined de Sitter conjecture? The comparison concerns conventional slow-roll dynamics and modified dynamics on a brane, while keeping potential curvature distinct from the dynamical slow-roll parameter.

sources.title: Scalar Weak Gravity Conjecture in Super Yang-Mills Inflationary Model

evidence.text: Which field regions of four composite inflation potentials satisfy both scalar weak-gravity inequalities, alongside previously reported further-refined de Sitter compatibility?

sources.title: Minimal gauge inflation and the refined Swampland conjecture

evidence.text: Determine whether minimal gauge inflation can obey the refined de Sitter disjunction across its selected field branch and fit the quoted CMB inputs, thereby restricting the unknown universal constants c1 and c2.

sources.title: Features of de Sitter vacua in M-theory

evidence.text: What scalar mass spectra and cosmological applications follow from the unstable de Sitter critical points of a G2 M-theory flux toy model? Can these points support conventional inflation or present accelerated expansion, and do their masses exhibit the integrality observed in earlier supergravity examples?

sources.title: A Solution to the de Sitter Swampland Conjecture versus Inflation Tension via Supergravity

evidence.text: Can supergravity reconcile a positive canonical inflationary potential with a non-positive potential used in the de Sitter conjectures? The proposed construction separates these potentials through an overall sign reversal of a superconformal scalar-gravity action.

sources.title: A Thermodynamic Positivity Bound on Higher-Derivative 3-Form Couplings in de Sitter, and its Inflationary Consequences

evidence.text: Can positivity of higher-derivative corrections to de Sitter black-hole entropy constrain 3-form couplings and, assuming those couplings also govern cosmology, restrict slow-roll inflation?

sources.title: A multiverse outside of the swampland

evidence.text: Can inflation populate a multiverse that scans the cosmological constant and weak scale while satisfying distance and refined de Sitter conjectures, even without de Sitter minima? If de Sitter minima are allowed, is eternal inflation necessary?

sources.title: Eternal Inflation and the Refined Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Can eternal inflation near a single-field potential maximum coexist with the refined de Sitter conjecture? The comparison concerns a tachyonic hilltop branch that avoids the original positive-gradient requirement.

sources.title: Inflation, swampland and landscape

evidence.text: Can string-inspired tip inflation satisfy the alternative gradient and curvature conditions of the refined de Sitter conjecture, and which parameter regions do the authors identify as compatible with inflationary observations?

sources.title: Higgs Inflation and the Refined dS Conjecture

evidence.text: Can the Higgs act as the inflaton while its potential satisfies the refined de Sitter conjecture throughout the field interval needed for inflation? The paper asks which conjecture constants permit this and whether observations exclude that region.

sources.title: de Sitter swampland bound in the Dirac-Born-Infeld inflation model

evidence.text: How should a de Sitter constraint restrict inflation when a relativistic brane can move on a steep potential while H changes slowly? The paper first constrains geometric evolution and then translates the constraint into potential data.

sources.title: Pixelated Dark Energy

evidence.text: Can the proposed F-theory Spin(7) construction generate inflation, reheating and evolving late dark energy through changing spacetime pixel number, and provide a microscopic account of de Sitter thermodynamic scalings without a fundamental inflaton?

sources.title: Inflation, Higher Spins and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can inflation support a tower with arbitrarily high spins when each fixed-spin mass decreases exponentially with geodesic field distance? The investigation asks how de Sitter mass–spin constraints interact with this limit and whether string excitations provide an exception.

sources.title: Reheating constraints on the inflaton and dark matter: Swampland conjecture

evidence.text: Can varying the shape scale of a supergravity-inspired plateau maintain observational agreement while bringing the conjecture parameters toward order unity?

sources.title: Cosmology of linear Higgs-sigma models with conformal invariance

evidence.text: Which higher-curvature extensions admit linear Higgs–sigma descriptions compatible with perturbative Higgs-inflation completion, and which sigma potentials support early inflation or late-time tracker dark energy? How do Higgs–sigma interactions affect these cosmologies and vacuum stability?

sources.title: Palatini Higgs inflation and the refined dS conjecture

evidence.text: Can the positive inflationary plateau of Palatini Higgs inflation satisfy either branch of the refined de Sitter conjecture with positive order-one constants, while remaining compatible with the quoted cosmological constraints and its assumed inflationary regime?

sources.title: Distance-Higuchi Bounds on Inflationary Field Ranges and Lifetimes

evidence.text: Can distance-dependent spin-2 masses and Higuchi consistency yield a polynomial upper bound on quasi-de Sitter duration, including ultra-flat potentials and cosmologies settling into metastable de Sitter?

sources.title: Primordial black hole tower: Dark matter, earth-mass, and LIGO black holes

evidence.text: Can positive-potential inflation satisfy the field-space restrictions conjectured for effective theories admitting quantum-gravity completion?

sources.title: Lorentz violating inflation and the swampland

evidence.text: The Higgs application asks whether a fixed exponential plateau shape can meet the paper's Lorentz-violating compatibility test after its scalar tilt is fitted at φ_i ≃ m_p.

sources.title: de Sitter swampland bound in the Dirac-Born-Infeld inflation model

evidence.text: Can an entropy-based de Sitter conjecture constrain higher-derivative inflation without a potential-gradient condition? The missing construction is a controlled mass-descent parameter and associated light-state entropy over the theory's actual field range.

destination.title: Compactification spectra, hierarchies and effective-theory control
destination.question: How do compactification geometry and interactions determine light sectors, scale hierarchies and the validity of lower-dimensional effective descriptions?
destination.summary: A proposed navigation family spanning geometric spectra, physical truncation, competing towers, cosmological scales and interaction tests. Charge constructions and coupling conjectures provide adjacent routes; soft supersymmetry-breaking phenomenology has a separate home. Numerical proximity does not establish scientific equivalence.

systems: Geometric, warped, graph and nongeometric compactifications
String and M-theory examples with KK, wrapped-brane or extended-object sectors
Lower-dimensional theories with source-specific dimensions and field content
targets: Spectra, light modes and hierarchy mechanisms
Physical validity and radiative stability of effective descriptions
Identification of relevant towers and limiting regimes
Relations between cosmological and compactification scales
Interaction and coupling tests involving compactification states
regimes: Classical, quantum-corrected and regulated loop analyses, kept distinct
assumptions: Each construction retains its own geometry, sources, stabilization and boundary data
Conjectures are questions or conditional frameworks, not shared established premises
Ordinary and pre-Swampland work remains eligible
conventions: Geometric eigenvalues need not equal interacting physical masses
Frame, kinetic normalization and Planck normalization remain source-specific
Symbols for dimension, volume and vacuum energy retain their source meanings
includes: Different mechanisms and dimensions within a broad family
Methodological limits on identifying a physical low-energy sector
Useful comparison and alternate routes beyond the direct KK-control core
excludes: A universal volume-only formula for every KK gap
Equivalence of questions inferred from shared KK terminology
Universal validation or rejection of compactification conjectures
Treating mixed-mediation phenomenology as a direct KK-separation test

sources.title: General Continuum Clockwork

evidence.text: Which discrete clockwork features survive continuum realizations, and how do independently adjustable warping, extra-dimensional volume and zero-mode localization affect KK spectra, boundary couplings and axion field range?

sources.title: Emergent strings from infinite distance limits

evidence.text: Does quantum-volume growth imply decompactification, and can the Planck scale remain finite? The answer depends on the coupling path and on possible strings competing with D0 or geometric KK towers.

sources.title: Quantum Log-Corrections to Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: Can an explicit anisotropic compactification generate small W0 and reveal a tower missed by an isotropic KK estimate?

sources.title: KKLT and the Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: Does proportionality of a loop metric correction preserve a truncation that omits light KK states?

sources.title: Compactified Spacelike Extra Dimension & Brane-Higgs Field

evidence.text: How should bulk fermions coupled to a brane-localized Higgs be treated consistently without arbitrary regularization, and can compactification on star/rose graphs combine large volume, high KK scale and weak visible couplings?

sources.title: The gravitino and the swampland

evidence.text: Which compactification scale supplies the proposed light tower? The paper primarily uses KK modes and estimates their Planck-normalized mass from an isotropic internal volume.

sources.title: Toroidal & Orbifold Compactifications at Large D and D-Duality

evidence.text: How do compactification spectra depend on the number D of internal dimensions, and can heavy KK towers at large D be accommodated by a duality exchanging them with wrapped-brane towers rather than by excluding that regime?

sources.title: Alice in Warpland: KK modes, Warped Compactifications and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can persistent warping reduce the exponential lightening rate of scalar KK towers below the Sharpened Distance Conjecture bound, and how does this depend on the higher-dimensional potential and defect codimension?

sources.title: General Continuum Clockwork

evidence.text: Solves background metric/dilaton equations with an exponential ansatz and boundary matching. Quadratic KK analysis uses Φc=e^(kΦ|y|)Φ, Bessel-function mode solutions and boundary quantization; κ=0 requires a separate trigonometric expression.

sources.title: Emergent strings from infinite distance limits

evidence.text: Continue periods and use their ratios to identify the small-fiber endpoint. Interpret the continuation as a modular transformation or quotient monodromy; the complete three-fold implementation is imported.

sources.title: Quantum Log-Corrections to Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: Estimate vacuum energy and canonical Hessian from balanced exponential terms, retaining the assumption that neither quantity has an additional cancellation.

sources.title: KKLT and the Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: Construct and solve the background-dependent fluctuation equation before inferring scale separation. Compare physical eigenvalues with moduli masses rather than identifying every KK mass with one inverse radius.

sources.title: Compactified Spacelike Extra Dimension & Brane-Higgs Field

evidence.text: Compares a direct 5D wave-function/boundary-condition calculation with a 4D construction using free KK profiles and an infinite fermion mass matrix. Bi-diagonalization determines physical masses; the Yukawa matrix must be rotated separately.

sources.title: The gravitino and the swampland

evidence.text: Expand around the original minimum, differentiate the added inverse-volume potential, and test the resulting displacement against the local expansion and mass sensitivity. Transport the AdS tower only when these checks hold.

sources.title: A Large mass hierarchy from a small extra dimension

evidence.text: Can a nonfactorizable five-dimensional geometry generate the Planck–weak hierarchy exponentially using one small extra dimension, without a very large compactification volume?

sources.title: de Sitter swampland bound in the Dirac-Born-Infeld inflation model

evidence.text: How near the throat can the probe move while omitting KK excitations around a light-particle scale m_0? The assumed criterion keeps the local KK gap above that scale.

sources.title: Anomalies as obstructions: from dimensional lifts to swampland

evidence.text: Which three- or five-dimensional Lagrangian theories can be obtained from a consistent circle compactification one dimension higher, once the massive Kaluza-Klein tower and its effective couplings are included?

sources.title: Emergent strings from infinite distance limits

evidence.text: How does the classical shrinking-K3 limit change in a concrete quantum compactification? The rank-one degree-12 example permits a period analysis with named integral brane charges.

sources.title: Kaluza–Klein Schwinger Effect

evidence.text: Can a weak electric field along a compact dimension nonperturbatively produce KK particles below the nominal KK energy scale, and when does this invalidate a four-dimensional description that discarded KK modes at the initial time?

sources.title: Fermions and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can wrapped-brane towers test scalar coupling limits while the tested scalar stays fixed? The construction uses Kähler cycle coordinates and axionic partners, explicitly acknowledging noncanonical normalization.

sources.title: Laplacian spectrum on a nilmanifold, truncations and effective theories

evidence.text: Can curvature generate massive modes below the internal momentum towers? Fixing the twist and enlarging the base relative to the fiber gives |f|≪1/r¹,1/r²≪1/r³.

sources.title: Membrane limits in quantum gravity

evidence.text: Does consistency of the Emergent String Conjecture under dimensional reduction forbid infinite-distance limits where a membrane becomes light at the KK scale, and how is this obstruction realized in Calabi–Yau compactifications?

sources.title: Newton versus Coulomb for Kaluza–Klein modes

evidence.text: How do explicit scattering and pair-production amplitudes of circle-compactified KK modes encode gauge, dilatonic, and scalar weak-gravity inequalities, and which comparisons remain valid under dimensional reduction, scalar masses, nonminimal curvature coupling, and higher-dimensional gauge interactions?

sources.title: Cheeger bounds on spin-two fields

evidence.text: When do bottlenecks in warped compactification spaces force light massive spin-two fields, and must higher modes also become light, including with brane singularities or infinite weighted volume?

sources.title: The EFT stringy viewpoint on large distances

evidence.text: The Joyce resolution allows bulk-radius KK towers to be compared with exceptional wrapped-M2 particles while distinguishing seven untwisted and 36 twisted periods.

sources.title: KKLT compactifications ex nihilo

evidence.text: Can brane systems sourcing putative KKLT-like AdS compactifications bound their infrared degrees of freedom, and thereby constrain the exponentially large hierarchy between AdS curvature and compactification scales?

sources.title: Exploring the landscape of (anti-) de Sitter and Minkowski solutions: group manifolds, stability and scale separation

evidence.text: Can a finite four-dimensional effective theory be separated in energy from an infinite tower of compactification modes?

sources.title: Weak gravity bounds in asymptotic string compactifications

evidence.text: Which lowering-operator descendants enter the asymptotic graviphoton analysis for I → III → IV? The enhancement data permit two applications of N_III and one of N_IV to the seed, and Table B.7 lists the resulting six charges.

sources.title: Asymptotic Weak Gravity Conjecture in M-theory on K3× K3

evidence.text: Can the asymptotic WGC extend to gravity-coupled 3D EFTs from finite-volume M-theory compactifications on K3×K3, including a proposed strong-coupling counterpart?

sources.title: Kaluza-Klein tower thresholds and scheme dependence of the species scale

evidence.text: How do cutoff profiles affect local four-derivative thresholds from infinite KK towers, and which large-N terms remain stable? The aim is to assess the parametric correspondence between perturbative-breakdown and higher-derivative characterizations of the species scale.

sources.title: Uber-naturalness: unexpectedly light scalars from supersymmetric extra dimensions

evidence.text: Can non-Goldstone scalars in large-volume string compactifications remain technically natural below both the KK and gravitino masses when the gravitational scale is parametrically below the four-dimensional Planck scale?

sources.title: Towards a string realization of the Dark Dimension via T-folds

evidence.text: Can type II T-fold compactifications generate the Dark Dimension scaling V∝mKK⁴ while fixing the five-dimensional fiber volume and leaving the Scherk–Schwarz base circle as the requisite large extra dimension?

sources.title: Cheeger bounds on spin-two fields

evidence.text: When do narrow bridges in an internal compactification produce a light massive graviton, and when must additional spin-two KK states also become light?

sources.title: Scattering amplitudes of massive spin-2 Kaluza-Klein states with matter

evidence.text: How do apparently O(s^3) matter-annihilation amplitudes producing longitudinal massive KK gravitons cancel, what geometric identities enforce this, and how does stabilization change the analysis?

sources.title: Accelerated Universes from type IIA Compactifications

evidence.text: Can non-isotropic geometric type IIA compactifications yield slowly evolving, transient accelerated cosmologies, and can such four-dimensional solutions also achieve perturbative string control and separation from the KK scale?

sources.title: The Swampland Distance Conjecture for Kähler moduli

evidence.text: How does decompactification make KK states light when particle masses and the lower-dimensional Planck scale depend on the frame used to compare radii?

sources.title: A LooKK at the Higuchi Bound

evidence.text: Can massive KK gravitons in a consistent compactification to dS4 violate the Higuchi bound, and can apparent violations diagnose inconsistent compactification data or neglected moduli?

sources.title: Laplacian spectrum on a nilmanifold, truncations and effective theories

evidence.text: What converts a geometric spectral truncation into a physical low-energy theory? Fluxes, kinetic normalization, and mass mixing can change the light combinations even when a preliminary KK hierarchy exists.

sources.title: Emergent strings from infinite distance limits

evidence.text: Can light membranes competing with KK modes provide an exception to emergent-string behavior in M-Theory complex-structure limits?

assumptions: Each source retains its own field content, hierarchy, coupling and control conditions.
A stabilized supersymmetric starting point and a stable uplifted endpoint are separate tests.
Proposed extensions and source-era phenomenological assessments remain qualified.
conventions: Source notation and dates are retained.
The undefined parameter s in the tip-volume calculation receives no inferred normalization.
includes: Conditional constructions and explicit negative results
Comparative reviews and neighboring questions with identified alternate homes
excludes: A universal uplift mechanism or mediation spectrum
Automatic equivalence of questions sharing KKLT terminology
Claims of current phenomenological viability or universal exclusion
Proof of de Sitter existence, ADC realization or cosmological selection from this packet alone

sources.title: More about F-term uplifting

evidence.text: Does direct nonperturbative coupling between a supersymmetry-breaking field and a Kähler modulus preserve F-term uplifting and the suppressed modulus F-term characteristic of KKLT-type models?

sources.title: O'KKLT at finite temperature

evidence.text: The effective O’KKLT model tests thermal volume stabilization while representing metastable supersymmetry breaking by one light uplifting field. One-exponential KKLT and two-exponential racetrack sectors provide the cases compared.

sources.title: Finite temperature behaviour of the ISS-uplifted KKLT model

evidence.text: Does the static finite-temperature phase structure of ISS-uplifted KKLT favor the supersymmetry-breaking metastable vacuum, and can thermal ISS corrections or supergravity displacement of the origin upset vacuum selection or modulus stabilization?

sources.title: The Boundaries of KKLT

evidence.text: How can localized KKLT uplift produce consistent UV and IR boundary conditions for static four-dimensional de Sitter slicing, when does the throat radion destabilize, and how is supersymmetry breaking communicated?

sources.title: An update on moduli stabilization with antibrane uplift

evidence.text: How does retaining the light conifold complex-structure field change KKLT vacuum structure, moduli masses, supersymmetry breaking, required localized D3 charge, and soft terms after antibrane uplift?

sources.title: Landscape, the scale of SUSY breaking, and inflation

evidence.text: How does the shape of the effective potential after KKLT uplifting relate supersymmetry breaking, the stabilizing barrier and inflationary Hubble scale, and can modified volume stabilization permit high-scale inflation with a small present gravitino mass?

sources.title: Stability of flux compactifications and the pattern of supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: When does retaining the dilaton and complex structure moduli alter KKLT stabilization before and after uplifting, and what supersymmetry-breaking mediation patterns follow?

sources.title: Dynamical gauge coupling unification from moduli stabilization

evidence.text: Can KKLT-type stabilization dynamically unify gauge couplings when Standard Model gauge factors originate on different wrapped cycles, while uplifting produces universal gaugino masses and acceptable CP and flavor properties?

sources.title: The Swampland Conjecture and F-term Axion Monodromy Inflation

evidence.text: Can LVS avoid the KKLT obstruction by allowing an effective superpotential parameter that need not be small, while retaining a light D7-position inflaton and a valid Kaluza–Klein cutoff?

sources.title: AdS and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can KKLT realize the ADC through towers controlled by dilaton, complex structure, or long throats, or is the formal small-W0 limit obstructed by flux-vacuum constraints? The source identifies explicit very-small-W0 moduli calculations as the missing test.

sources.title: Supersymmetry breaking and moduli stabilization with anomalous U(1) gauge symmetry

evidence.text: How does anomalous U(1)_A affect supersymmetry breaking and visible soft terms when its Green–Schwarz modulus is explicitly stabilized, particularly by KKLT, and can its D-term provide de Sitter uplifting?

sources.title: More about F-term uplifting

evidence.text: Integrate out heavy modes near the supersymmetry-breaking configuration and retain the leading quartic Kähler correction together with a linear effective superpotential.

sources.title: O'KKLT at finite temperature

evidence.text: Compute background-dependent masses, expand their one-loop thermal functions for masses much smaller than temperature, and retain T². Remove the field-independent radiation term only when taking field derivatives.

sources.title: Finite temperature behaviour of the ISS-uplifted KKLT model

evidence.text: Uses a one-loop effective potential consisting of the tree-level supergravity potential, a temperature-independent Coleman-Weinberg contribution, and thermal bosonic/fermionic integrals. High-temperature mass-trace expansions treat light modes; Boltzmann-suppressed low-temperature expansions treat heavy quarks near the supersymmetric vacua.

sources.title: The Swampland Conjecture and F-term Axion Monodromy Inflation

evidence.text: Lift an initially flat direction with a subleading coupling, track the induced inflaton and spectator masses, and test whether reducing the coupling delays backreaction without destabilizing saxions or lowering the effective-theory cutoff.

sources.title: AdS and the Swampland

evidence.text: Read the deformation norm from the Ricci-scalar kinetic expansion, impose transverse-traceless conditions, and average over spacetime. The trace restriction matters: this sector does not determine the sign or normalization of the external conformal direction.

sources.title: The Boundaries of KKLT

evidence.text: Solve warped five-dimensional Einstein equations and junction conditions with a Goldberger–Wise scalar fixed at the two boundaries. Retain its gradient energy: a perturbation of the throat length changes scalar derivatives and hence boundary matching.

sources.title: F-term Moduli Stabilization and Uplifting

evidence.text: Can a supersymmetry-breaking chiral field coupled to Kähler moduli through the Kähler potential stabilize the overall volume and uplift an LVS vacuum without substantially destabilizing it?

sources.title: Towards an Explicit Model of D-brane Inflation

evidence.text: How does uplift energy move the KKLT volume minimum? The tip potential provides a supersymmetric AdS reference, its depth and an inverse-square positive contribution.

sources.title: Stringy corrections to Kahler potentials, SUSY breaking, and the cosmological constant problem

evidence.text: Can string corrections to the Kähler potential alter KKLT-type moduli stabilization, produce supersymmetry-breaking AdS/Minkowski/metastable de Sitter minima, and permit a one-loop corrected cosmological constant much smaller than the supersymmetry-breaking scale?

sources.title: O'KKLT

evidence.text: Can quantum-corrected O’Raifeartaigh supersymmetry breaking uplift KKLT to a stabilized de Sitter vacuum while accommodating a light gravitino and a barrier sufficient for cosmological vacuum stability?

sources.title: Moduli stabilization in stringy ISS models

evidence.text: Can an ISS-like metastable SUSY-breaking sector survive when its mass becomes a dynamical modulus, and can that modulus and the modulus controlling a dynamical FI term be stabilized at finite gravitational coupling, potentially with tunably small positive vacuum energy?

sources.title: Supersymmetry and stability of flux vacua

evidence.text: Can a modified KKLT construction stabilize the axion-dilaton, complex structure and volume moduli at a supersymmetric Minkowski vacuum, thereby protecting stability when supersymmetry breaking and uplifting are sufficiently small?

sources.title: Soft supersymmetry breaking in KKLT flux compactification

evidence.text: What soft supersymmetry-breaking terms and mass hierarchies follow from KKLT stabilization followed by antibrane uplift, and under what conditions are the resulting spectra compatible with flavor and CP constraints?

sources.title: On the modified KKLT procedure: A Case study for the P(11169) [18] model

evidence.text: How should the modified KKLT procedure be implemented explicitly in the P11169[18] orientifold when the dilaton remains dynamical, and do the resulting equations admit supersymmetric vacua for selected flux families?

sources.title: Aspects of moduli stabilization in type IIB string theory

evidence.text: How do KKLT and LVS stabilize type IIB moduli, and what consequences follow for supersymmetry breaking, low-energy phenomenology, inflation, destabilization and moduli backreaction?

sources.title: String theoretic QCD axion with stabilized saxion and the pattern of supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Can a PQ-invariant generalization of KKLT stabilize the saxion while leaving the QCD axion unfixed until QCD effects arise, and what moduli spectrum, supersymmetry-breaking mediation, and flavor/CP properties follow?

sources.title: De Sitter string vacua from supersymmetric D terms

evidence.text: Can a modulus-dependent supersymmetric D-term replace the KKLT anti-D3 uplift, producing a metastable de Sitter vacuum with spontaneous supersymmetry breaking, and can the mechanism extend to heterotic strings?

sources.title: More about F-term uplifting

evidence.text: The effective theory isolates the light modulus whose stabilization and supersymmetry-breaking response can change when an uplifting field couples to it.

sources.title: Small cosmological constants in string theory

evidence.text: Can explicit KKLT-type supersymmetric AdS4 vacua simultaneously realize exponentially small flux superpotentials, enough independent nonperturbative terms to stabilize every Kähler modulus, and F-flat solutions inside the Kähler cone with controlled corrections?

sources.title: Moduli stabilization and uplifting with dynamically generated F-terms

evidence.text: Can dynamical F-term supersymmetry breaking uplift a KKLT vacuum to zero energy while retaining a TeV gravitino, stabilized moduli and a long lifetime, and what visible-sector soft terms follow?
